description: A file attached to a message or form, such as a transfer receipt photo, a PDF e-ticket, or an ID card. Shows a thumbnail or icon, the file name, details and actions.
tip: Set the state prop to follow the upload: idle (empty slot), uploading/processing (shimmering name), error (red), done.

images.title: Photos & clickable
images.description: orientation="vertical" with thumbnails. AttachmentTrigger makes the whole card clickable, and AttachmentGroup scrolls sideways.

parts.attachment: The attachment card; sets the state, size and orientation.
parts.content: Column with the title and description.
parts.title: File name; cut off with "…" when too long.
parts.description: Size, type, progress or error message.
parts.action: Small icon button (remove, download). Needs an aria-label.
parts.trigger: Invisible button that makes the whole card clickable.
parts.group: Row of attachments that scrolls sideways.

props.orientation: "vertical" for a large thumbnail on top.
